_about: Standard home-upkeep jobs read by scripts/build_home.py. 'every' is in whole months; 'season' is a list of season keys (see seasons). applies_if lists features (any one is enough); empty means every home. landlord=true means that in a rented home it is normally the landlord's job, so a renter's plan says 'Tell your landlord'. safety=true means the build never moves it later than its due date. title_uk / why_uk / who_uk / est_minutes_uk replace the plain field when words is uk. Intervals are the common, conservative published ones; a home's manual or local rules can say sooner.

fireplace.us: Wood fireplace, chimney or wood stove
fireplace.uk: Open fire, chimney or wood burner

basement.uk: Cellar or ground-floor rooms in a radon area

seasons._about: Month each season's jobs fall in. The southern hemisphere adds six months.

jobs.title: Test every smoke alarm
jobs.why: Press the test button on each one; a dead alarm gives no warning.

jobs.title: Test every carbon monoxide alarm
jobs.why: Carbon monoxide has no smell; the alarm is the only warning you get.

jobs.title: Fit new batteries in the smoke and CO alarms
jobs.why: Once a year, unless the alarm has a sealed 10-year battery; replace any alarm over 10 years old.

jobs.title: Check the fire extinguisher
jobs.why: Gauge in the green, pin and seal in place, easy to reach from the kitchen.

jobs.title: Press the test button on GFCI outlets
jobs.title_uk: Press the test button on the RCD in the fuse box
jobs.why: It should cut the power at once; if it doesn't, it won't protect you from a shock.
jobs.why_uk: It should trip at once; if it doesn't, it won't protect you from a shock.

jobs.title: Change the heating and AC air filter
jobs.why: A clogged filter makes the system work harder and lets dust through; every 1–2 months with pets or allergies.

jobs.title: Have the furnace serviced
jobs.why: A yearly check before the cold catches cracked heat exchangers and gas leaks, which cause carbon monoxide.

jobs.title: Have the boiler serviced
jobs.why: A yearly service by a qualified engineer before the cold; a gas boiler that isn't checked can leak carbon monoxide.
jobs.why_uk: A yearly service by a Gas Safe engineer before the cold; landlords must have gas appliances checked every year.

jobs.title: Bleed the radiators
jobs.why: Trapped air leaves cold patches at the top and makes the boiler work harder.

jobs.title: Have the AC or heat pump serviced
jobs.why: A check before the hot months, when repair waits are longest.

jobs.title: Clear leaves and debris from the outdoor AC unit
jobs.why: It needs about two feet of clear space around it to move air.

jobs.title: Have the chimney swept and inspected
jobs.why: Soot and creosote build-up causes chimney fires; once a year before the first fire.

jobs.title: Clean out the dryer vent duct
jobs.title_uk: Clean out the tumble-dryer vent hose
jobs.why: Lint packed in the duct is a leading cause of dryer fires.

jobs.title: Drain a few gallons from the water heater
jobs.title_uk: Check the hot-water cylinder and its pipes
jobs.why: Flushing out sediment keeps it heating well and lasting longer.
jobs.why_uk: Look for drips, damp lagging and a stiff valve before they become a leak.

jobs.title: Test the water heater's pressure-relief valve
jobs.title_uk: Have the unvented cylinder's safety valves checked
jobs.why: This valve stops the tank bursting if the pressure climbs; lift the lever and check water flows, then stops.
jobs.why_uk: These valves stop the cylinder bursting if the pressure climbs; an unvented cylinder needs a yearly check by a qualified installer.

jobs.title: Clean the gutters and check the downspouts
jobs.title_uk: Clear the gutters and check the downpipes
jobs.why: Blocked gutters overflow into walls and foundations; use a steady ladder and a helper, or hire it out.

jobs.title: Look over the roof from the ground
jobs.why: Missing or cracked shingles and loose flashing let water in; binoculars beat climbing up.
jobs.why_uk: Missing or slipped tiles and loose flashing let water in; binoculars beat climbing up.

jobs.title: Shut off and drain the outdoor faucets
jobs.title_uk: Turn off and drain the outside taps
jobs.why: Water left in the pipe freezes, splits it and floods when it thaws.

jobs.title: Drain the sprinkler system for winter
jobs.title_uk: Drain the irrigation system for winter
jobs.why: Frozen water cracks the pipes and heads underground, where the leak is hard to find.

jobs.title: Turn the sprinklers back on and check each zone
jobs.title_uk: Turn the irrigation back on and check each zone
jobs.why: A broken head can waste hundreds of gallons before anyone notices.

jobs.title: Open the pool or hot tub for the season
jobs.why: Balance the water and check the pump and filter before anyone swims.

jobs.title: Close the pool or hot tub for the season
jobs.why: Lower the water, protect the pipes from frost and cover it.

jobs.title: Check the pool fence, gate latch and cover
jobs.why: A self-closing, self-latching gate is the main thing that keeps small children out.

jobs.title: Have the septic tank inspected and pumped
jobs.why: Every 3 years for most households; an overfull tank backs up into the house and the drain field.

jobs.title: Have the well water tested
jobs.title_uk: Have the private water supply tested
jobs.why: Once a year for bacteria, nitrates and anything local; a well is nobody else's job to check.

jobs.title: Test the sump pump
jobs.why: Pour a bucket of water into the pit; it should switch on and empty it before the heavy rains.

jobs.title: Test for radon
jobs.why: Radon is an invisible gas that causes lung cancer; a cheap kit tells you, retest every 2 years.

jobs.title: Test the garage door's auto-reverse
jobs.why: Close it on a roll of paper towels; it must reverse, or it can crush a child or a pet.

jobs.title: Check the car's tire pressure and tread
jobs.title_uk: Check the car's tyre pressure and tread
jobs.why: Under-inflated tires wear out faster, waste fuel and grip worse; check them cold.
jobs.why_uk: Under-inflated tyres wear out faster, waste fuel and grip worse; check them cold.

jobs.title: Book the car's yearly service
jobs.why: Oil, brakes and fluids; follow the car's manual if it says sooner.

jobs.title: Get the car ready for winter
jobs.why: Wiper blades, washer fluid, battery and a blanket and scraper in the trunk.
jobs.why_uk: Wiper blades, screenwash, battery and a blanket and scraper in the boot.

jobs.title: Find and turn the main water shut-off
jobs.why: In a burst pipe you need it in seconds, and a valve that is never turned seizes.

jobs.title: Look for drips under sinks and around the toilet
jobs.why: A slow leak rots the cabinet floor long before you see a puddle.

jobs.title: Check the caulk around the bath and shower
jobs.title_uk: Check the sealant around the bath and shower
jobs.why: Water through a gap gets behind the tiles and into the floor.

jobs.title: Vacuum the fridge's condenser coils
jobs.why: Dusty coils make the fridge run hotter and longer.

jobs.title: Clean the range hood filter
jobs.why: Grease builds up in the mesh and can catch fire above the stove.
jobs.why_uk: Grease builds up in the mesh and can catch fire above the hob.

jobs.title: Clean the dishwasher filter
jobs.why: Food caught in the filter leaves grit on the dishes and a smell.

jobs.title: Run a hot cleaning cycle on the washing machine
jobs.why: Stops mold and smells in the seal and drum; wipe the door seal too.
jobs.why_uk: Stops mould and smells in the seal and drum; wipe the door seal too.

jobs.title: Dust the bathroom fan cover
jobs.why: A clogged fan leaves damp in the room, and damp becomes mold.
jobs.why_uk: A clogged fan leaves damp in the room, and damp becomes mould.

jobs.title: Check door and window seals for drafts
jobs.title_uk: Check door and window seals for draughts
jobs.why: Worn weather-stripping lets heat out all winter; it is cheap to replace.

jobs.title: Check the emergency kit and flashlights
jobs.title_uk: Check the emergency kit and torches
jobs.why: Water, batteries, first aid and medicines go out of date; swap what has.

jobs.title: Check the deck or balcony for loose boards and railings
jobs.why: Rot and loose railings fail without warning, usually when the deck is full of people.

jobs.title: Spring yard tidy and mower tune-up
jobs.title_uk: Spring garden tidy and mower service
jobs.why: Sharp blade, fresh oil and clear beds before the grass takes off.

jobs.title: Rake leaves and put the yard to bed
jobs.title_uk: Clear leaves and put the garden to bed
jobs.why: Wet leaves kill the lawn underneath; drain and store hoses before the frost.

jobs.title: Look for dead branches over the house and paths
jobs.why: Dead limbs come down in the first big storm; call a tree surgeon for anything above head height.
